body:
Triage grade under the maintainer's dispatch hold (「创建卡片,暂时不派发。」, quoted in the body): `domain:skills` · `priority:p3` · `tracking` added. `pm:on-hold` stays, and so does the body's `Restart-when:` line (the maintainer or the director lifts the hold).

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T06:01Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **`tracking`:** this is a program anchor. Each of W1–W7 becomes its own card when work starts, and the anchor itself never enters `pm:queue`.
- **Why p3:** these are long-horizon cost items. No gate judges wrongly while they wait, and the card itself says ⛔ no change to any verdict.
- **Dedupe:** the open board has no other card on these items (MCP `search_issues`, objectstack, over dispatch-gates NOT MEASURED, the section body patch, the guard-script split and the platform-readings diet). Every hit is closed, apart from this card.
- **For the restart:**
  - **W2 and W3 are decisions** (ceilings from 0 for 13 files; lifting ruling 208's freeze for the `dispatch-gates.mjs` split). Each is filed as its own `needs-user-decision` card for the director, ⛔ not folded into a child's PR body.
  - **Each child is a `tooling` card.** When it enters `pm:queue`, its first line carries `Unblocks: #N` or names the surface it guards.

Maintainer ruling recorded — the 2026-10-07 dispatch hold on this program anchor is lifted. Provenance, three items: the maintainer (os-elon-musk); verbatim 「skills 车道所有卡都可以派发」 (read 2026-10-09T09:10Z), after 「你可以派发」 (read 2026-10-09T00:11Z); said in this seat's session chat (`session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA`). They answer the `Restart-when:` line of this card. Skills seat 1 (seat post #7623), 2026-10-09T09:30Z.

State: `pm:on-hold` removed in this act; the anchor itself never enters `pm:queue` (the triage grade 6032010144). What follows, in the order the grade asked: W1 (the platform-readings diet) is filed as the first `tooling` child with its guarded surface on its first line and dispatched in the lane's next round; W2 (ceilings for the ceiling-0 references) and W3 (the `dispatch-gates.mjs` unfreeze-and-split under ruling 208 R6, which also carries #22167's remainder) are each filed as a `needs-user-decision` card before any code is written; W4–W7 follow as `tooling` children, one per fire. Nothing is claimed here.

## Program progress after the hold lift — skills seat 1, `session_01JmWtcHfGbC4ncw4GFKWuRA`, 2026-10-09T09:38Z

- **W1 (platform-readings diet):** filed as #22452 (`tooling` · `domain:skills` · `priority:p3` · `pm:queue`, guarded surface on its first line, `Part of #22060`) — the lane's next pick after this round's three in-flight cards.
- **W2 (ceilings for the ceiling-0 references):** **measured done, dropped** — on `origin/main` `da159f74e6` the ratchet prints a non-zero ceiling for every reference file (`node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`: 0 rows read `ceiling 0`; the 13 ceiling-0 rows the filing counted are not there). No card; nothing to decide.
- **W3 (`dispatch-gates.mjs` unfreeze-and-split):** filed as the decision card #22453 (`needs-user-decision`), options A / B / C with the four-facet block; #22167's remainder rides its letter.
- **W4–W7:** one per fire, after W1 and W3 move.

Checklist: W1 → #22452 (queued) · W2 → done (measured) · W3 → #22453 (decision box) · W4 · W5 · W6 · W7 (not yet filed).
